title: AD 3 · «أنا الخيط اللي تقطع» (victim, inside the skin)

hook_card.text:
علاش الخطوط ما كيمشيوش بالزيت؟
حيت المشكل لتحت… عندي أنا

shots.vo_line: كتشوفي فكرشك خطوط: حمرين فالأول، ومن بعد بيضين ومحفورين. وكتقولي: علاش ما بغاوش يمشيو؟ الجواب عندي أنا.
shots.row: Close-up of a belly with red and white lines, then the camera dives under the skin to a cute pink elastic thread character with big eyes
shots.h3_prompt: The belly breathes slowly in and out while the red lines pulse softly and the pale lines shimmer. Beneath the skin the pink fibres stretch and ripple and the glowing bubbles bob gently. A soft pink glow keeps pulsing deep in the tissue like a heartbeat until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Speaker (the thread) is not in this frame, so no talking; the row's camera dive under the skin cannot be done with a static camera - the cut to A3-02 has to carry it. A small baby-like arm at the left edge reads oddly next to a realistic, faceless belly (not the C4 belly character).

shots.vo_line: أنا الخيط اللي كنشد الجلد ديالك من لتحت، بحال اللاستيك.
shots.row: A row of thread characters holding hands; the main one stretching thin and snapping, holding her two halves with a bandage
shots.h3_prompt: The threads sway and stretch side to side like elastic bands, still holding hands. The center thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while she is pulled thinner, her halves spring apart with a small spark and she wobbles in shock. The others gasp and keep bouncing nervously toward her. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: The frame already shows the snap (not the moment before), and the bandage is on a different thread (right of center) than the snapping main one, while A3-03 shows the main thread bandaged - can read as two different characters.

shots.vo_line: فالحمل الكرش كبرات بالزربة، وأنا تجبدت حتى
shots.row: A row of thread characters holding hands; the main one stretching thin and snapping, holding her two halves with a bandage
shots.h3_prompt: The bandaged thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while she looks up at the red line above, which pulses softly. She stretches up tall and thin on tiptoe, wobbling, then sags back down. She keeps clutching her bandage and swaying sadly, blinking up at the line. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: تقطعت. وفين تقطعت، بان الخط من الفوق. ونتي كتدهني من الفوق: الشبة كتحرق الجلد اللي
shots.row: Alum crystals, oil drops and cream blobs landing on the skin "ceiling" above her and staying there; she looks up sadly
shots.h3_prompt: The crystals on the ceiling jitter and fizz with tiny sparkles. The bandaged thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while she points up at them, flinching at each fizz, then hugs her bandage. She keeps looking up sadly, slowly shaking her head, while the other thread sways and blinks. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: فوقي، الزيت كيبقى تما بحال الزيت فوق الما، والكريمة كترطب الفوق… وحتى حاجة ما كتوصل ليا.
shots.row: Alum crystals, oil drops and cream blobs landing on the skin "ceiling" above her and staying there; she looks up sadly
shots.h3_prompt: The golden oil drops on the ceiling wobble and slide slowly sideways without dripping, and the cream blobs stay put. The bandaged thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while she rises on tiptoe and reaches up, falling short. She sinks back, drooping, and keeps shaking her head sadly. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: …شنو هادا؟ قطرة خفيفة… كتدخل… كتنزل… وصلات ليا! هادي غوتيفا: سيروم خفيف، الجلد كيشربو كامل. زيت
shots.row: One golden Guttiva drop slipping through the ceiling and falling gently to her; she opens her arms
shots.h3_prompt: The golden drop slips free and drifts slowly down and to the right in a sparkling spiral. The bandaged thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while she looks up in wonder and opens her arms as the drop sinks into her bandage with a warm glow. She keeps swaying and smiling while the other thread bounces happily. Static camera. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: In the frame the thread reaching for the drop is the un-bandaged one (left); the speaker is the bandaged one (right). The motion steers the drop to her, but H3 may still hand it to the left thread - check.

shots.vo_line: أركان كيغذيني، فيتامين E كيعاوني نرجع نتشد ونبرا، والألوفيرا كتبرد. الزيت والكريمة بقاو فوق… هي وحدها اللي وصلات لتحت.
shots.row: Argan leaves, a vitamin E capsule and aloe sparks around her; her halves glowing and joining; all threads strong, the ceiling smooth
shots.h3_prompt: The leaves, the golden capsule and the aloe pieces circle slowly around the two threads on the swirl of sparkles. The right thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while a warm glow pulses along her middle. Both stretch tall, spring back like elastic and keep bouncing happily, holding hands. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Neither thread has a bandage or a seam, so 'her halves glowing and joining' is only a glow along her middle; which thread is the speaker is ambiguous (motion makes the right one talk, as she stood right in A3-04/A3-05).

shots.vo_line: دقيقتين الصباح والعشية… فـ30 يوم الحمورية خفّات، فـ60 الخط بدا كيمشي، وفـ90 يوم رجعت مشدودة بحال قبل.
shots.row: Argan leaves, a vitamin E capsule and aloe sparks around her; her halves glowing and joining; all threads strong, the ceiling smooth
shots.h3_prompt: The two threads swing their joined hands and sway side to side in rhythm. The right thread talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures while they stretch long and snap back firm and tight, beaming. They keep dancing gently together, glowing, as the leaves and aloe pieces drift around them. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Same frame as s07: speaker = the right thread.

shots.vo_line: غوتيفا. جوج قراعي ب299 درهم بلاصة 398.
